question: How long was the planned duration of the Ax‑4 mission aboard the ISS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14–21 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4)** is the fourth planned private astronaut mission to the **International Space Station (ISS)**, managed by the private **American** company **Axiom Space**.
 
• The mission is scheduled to have a total duration of approximately **14–21 days**, which includes the time required for travel, docking, and the **14-day** stay at the orbiting laboratory for conducting scientific research. ***Hence, the correct answer is 14–21 days.***
 
• This mission is a landmark event for the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, as it involves the participation of an **Indian Gaganyaatri** (astronaut) in a joint mission with **NASA**.
 
• **Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla** has been identified as the primary astronaut from **India** for the **Ax-4** mission, while **Group Captain Prasanth Balakrishnan Nair** has been named as the backup.
 
• The mission utilizes the **SpaceX Dragon** spacecraft and is launched via the **Falcon 9** rocket from the **Kennedy Space Center** in **Florida, USA**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Collaboration:**

 
 
• The **Ax-4** mission is a result of a bilateral agreement between **India** and the **United States**, solidified during **Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s** state visit to the **USA** in **June 2023**.
 
• The collaboration falls under the **iCET (Initiative on Critical and Emerging Technology)** framework, aimed at enhancing cooperation in space exploration and high-end technology.
 
 
 
• **The Crew Members:**
 
 
• The mission is commanded by **Peggy Whitson**, a veteran **NASA** astronaut and the **Axiom Space** Director of Human Spaceflight, who holds the record for the most cumulative time spent in space by an **American**.
 
• Other crew members include **Sławosz Uznański** from **Poland** (representing the **European Space Agency**) and **Tibor Kapu** from **Hungary**, making it a truly multi-national expedition.
 
 
 
• **Training and Preparation:**
 
 
• The **Indian** astronauts selected for this mission undergo rigorous training at **NASA's Johnson Space Center** in **Houston, Texas**.
 
• The training includes **ISS** system operations, emergency protocols, microgravity adaptation, and specific payload handling related to the scientific experiments planned for the **14–21 days** duration.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• This mission marks the return of an **Indian** citizen to space after a gap of several decades. The first **Indian** in space was **Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma**, who flew to the **Soviet Salyut 7** space station in **1984**.
 
• While **Indian-origin** astronauts like **Kalpana Chawla** and **Sunita Williams** have flown with **NASA**, **Shubhanshu Shukla** represents the official **Indian** space program’s push toward the **Gaganyaan** mission goals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mission Significance:** The **Ax-4** mission serves as a precursor to **India’s** own human spaceflight program, **Gaganyaan**, by providing **ISRO** with valuable experience in international docking standards and **ISS** operations.
 
• **Scientific Objectives:** During their stay, the crew will perform approximately **25+** different **experiments** focusing on human health, biology, and physical sciences in a microgravity environment.
 
• **Axiom Space's Vision:** Axiom Space aims to build the **Axiom Station**, the world’s first commercial space station, which will eventually detach from the **ISS** to operate independently.
